prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving–shipping release; pallets stay inside; dispatch accuracy/timeliness, safety/inventory compliance. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass): authoritative inventory/location/eligibility/tasks/constraints; authorizes moves/reservations, prevents duplicates; produces Slot Reservation Receipt; sends Dispatch Wave Amendment(destination/priority/load-sequence); consumes Oversize Load Advisory/Aisle Occupancy Snapshot; reconciles sensors before recovery, transaction times/completions against shift plan. Requests: unique task-reference/destination/safety-constraints. Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook): validates vehicle/carrier/trailer/window; directs/holds/reassigns drivers; consumes Trailer Seal Exception Note; controls access, holds recovery-affected vehicles outside. Yard personnel notify receiving of departure-readiness. Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay): checks identity/seals/documents/counts/expectations; separates damage; sends exception note, consumes inspection advisory; records proceed/rework/hold; reviewed holds. Inbound Pallet Buffer≠acceptance; isolation-intersecting access unavailable. Closure/allocation requires count/inspection/door-release records. Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry): produces Oversize Load Advisory, checks dimensional tolerances; exceptions held. Allocation requires dimensions/mass/compatibility/retrievability/clearance/restricted-position approval. Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven): produces Transfer Induction Ticket; identification/presence/interlocks/downstream-readiness/single-admission required; inhibits duplicates/blockages/uncertainty/isolation-feeding/incomplete-restart/protective-state-change. East Transfer Conveyor/West Transfer Conveyor stop for boundary threats. East restart: empty/reduced-speed/full-cycle; record authorization/speed/result/alarms. Autonomous Forklift Fleet (Larkspur): receives ticket/recovery-route hold; validates vehicle/route/destination/pickup/identity; pedestrian/access/speed controls; produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation. North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake)/South Aisle Stacker Crane: separated aisles/controlled-crossings/valid-targets; North consumes reservation receipt, produces occupancy snapshot; verifies clearance, stops for obstruction; stale reports hold induction; faults require inspection. Maintenance Release Terminal (Copperfield): inspection/repairs/authorizer; produces Crane Service Release Card; check before automatic-service return. Recovery: discrepancy/obstruction/alarm; Fire Alarm Panel/Safety Zone Controller retain stop authority; latter isolates/blocks-entry, applies Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice until

New part:
S217: At handover, the outgoing shift records equipment restrictions, pending checks, and unresolved safety concerns.
S218: The incoming shift acknowledges those conditions before authorizing routine movements.
S219: Commissioning acceptance is conducted against an approved test plan before routine warehouse operation begins.
S220: The test plan defines expected behavior, safety limits, evidence requirements, and criteria for blocking release.
S221: Each subsystem is exercised under representative loads, including recovery from interrupted transactions and controlled equipment stops.
S222: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor confirms that acceptance evidence is complete and that any remaining limitations are documented.
S223: The Warehouse Management System is checked for inventory accuracy, transaction integrity, and correct handling of unavailable storage locations.
S224: Acceptance is withheld when a material defect could compromise personnel safety, inventory control, or shipment accuracy.
S225: The Warehouse Management System uses the handoff confirmation to close the applicable movement record.
S226: The Shipping Documentation Desk receives and reconciles the Gross Weight Variance Slip against the applicable shipment record before completing its paperwork.
S227: A scale variance outside the approved tolerance is investigated and resolved before the affected shipment is released.
S228: The North Aisle Stacker Crane accepts the release card as authorization to return to service after its checks are complete.
S229: A crane remains unavailable for automated assignments until its functional checks and required safety checks have passed.
S230: Morrowglass closes the commissioning action register only after unresolved findings have named owners and due dates.
S231: Cinderbay records governance approval and confirms that the accepted operating configuration is under change control.
S232: Brasshaven verifies that conveyor zones are clear and records the completion of its assigned closing checks.
S233: Larkspur parks its vehicles in approved locations and reports any remaining equipment restrictions for the next shift.
S234: Copperfield records completed service work and confirms that equipment restrictions remain visible until formally cleared.
S235: The Fire Alarm Panel is checked for active faults, bypasses, and indications requiring escalation before the facility is released.
S236: The Safety Zone Controller is verified against the approved access boundaries and stop-response behavior.
S237: The Inbound Inspection Desk and Outbound Dispatch Sorter confirm that their operating interfaces are available and that exceptions can be held safely.
S238: Changes to software, equipment settings, or operating procedures require an impact review, approval, and a controlled implementation record.
S239: Emergency changes are documented promptly and reviewed by the Warehouse Operations Supervisor before normal operation resumes.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
